name: FORGE
features: Optional per-exercise rest preferences (60, 90 or 120 seconds) saved locally per verified account or guest profile
Rest preference only applies after an explicit button press; ongoing countdown reset requires confirmation
Next-set context displays validated completed sets from this session or the latest earlier workout, without inventing targets
Explicit pause/resume session note does not mark sets or workouts complete or upload new cloud records
Session status resets on account, day, routine and exercise-list changes
Accessible mobile controls and automated regression coverage for guest isolation, missing history and account switching
